summary: John Hancock Comvest Private Income Fund (JHCPIF) filed an 8-K reporting entry into a merger agreement to acquire Manulife Private Credit Fund (MPCF). Under the plan, JHCPIF's wholly-owned subsidiary Merger Sub will merge into MPCF, then the surviving entity will merge into JHCPIF, with JHCPIF as the ultimate survivor. Each MPCF common share will convert into JHCPIF Class I common shares at an Exchange Ratio based on relative net asset values to be finally determined post-close. Both BDC boards, including independent trustees, approved the deal, which is intended to be tax-free as a reorganization under Section 368(a). What to watch: final NAV calculations and regulatory clearance for the BDC-to-BDC merger.
